characterList.description: A woman with short brown hair, wearing a black top, who is interviewed against a backdrop of a glass window and some greenery.
characterList.name: Kirsten Miller

content_metadata.description: An instructional video where Kirsten Miller demonstrates how to add overlay images and video clips to an interview using Windows Movie Maker.

qAndA.answer: She is using Windows Movie Maker.
qAndA.question: What software is Kirsten Miller using in this tutorial?

qAndA.answer: She does this to create a separate audio track that she can use to precisely align the overlay images, as Movie Maker doesn't have a dedicated overlay track.
qAndA.question: Why does Kirsten export just the audio of the interview clip?

qAndA.answer: She adds images related to the topics the interviewee discusses, including a city park, a solar house, and a wind turbine.
qAndA.question: What kind of images does Kirsten add as overlays?

qAndA.answer: She splits the audio track to remove a slight echo caused by having overlapping clips where the original audio and the exported audio track were both playing at the same time.
qAndA.question: Why does Kirsten split the audio track?

qAndA.answer: The video has an informative and instructional tone. Its purpose is to teach viewers how to add overlay images to an interview using Windows Movie Maker.
qAndA.question: What is the overall tone and purpose of the video?

activities.description: Kirsten talks about the process of adding overlay images and video clips into an interview in Movie Maker.

narrativeProgression.description: Kirsten explains that the purpose of overlay images is to provide visuals related to what the interviewee is talking about.

scenes.thematicElements: Video editing techniques, overlay images, interviews.
scenes.title: Introducing Overlay Images in Movie Maker

videoEditingDetails.description: Text overlay: 'Demo: add 'overlay' clips in Movie Maker'
The video clip of Kirsten Miller is displayed in the timeline with several other smaller clips beneath.

activities.description: Kirsten saves the current project as 'OverlayProject.'
She removes all video clips except for the one she's going to add overlays to.
She exports the audio of the selected video clip.
Kirsten re-imports the audio into the project to verify its accuracy and identify a slight gap at the start.

narrativeProgression.description: Kirsten prepares the project file for adding the overlay images.

scenes.title: Preparing the Project for Overlay Images

videoEditingDetails.description: Zooming into the timeline to show details.

activities.description: Kirsten plays the audio and identifies the section where she wants to insert overlay images.

narrativeProgression.description: Kirsten determines the exact timestamps for where the overlay images will be placed.

videoEditingDetails.description: Playing the audio and video clip simultaneously.
Using the 'split tool' in Movie Maker to divide the video clip into sections.

activities.description: Kirsten imports the selected audio file into the project and notices a slight timing discrepancy.
She adjusts the audio start point using the 'set start point' option to better align it with the video clip.

keyMoments.changeDescription: Focus transitions to concern over timing issues.

narrativeProgression.description: Kirsten makes small adjustments to ensure the audio and video are as synchronized as possible.

videoEditingDetails.description: Zooming in on the timeline to show timing details.
Playing the adjusted audio and video clip to check synchronization.

activities.description: Kirsten removes the middle section of the video clip to make space for the overlay images.
She imports four photos related to the interview topic.
Kirsten arranges the images in the timeline and adjusts their durations to match the removed video clip's length.

keyMoments.changeDescription: Focus changes to satisfaction with arrangement.

narrativeProgression.description: Kirsten inserts and adjusts the overlay images, achieving rough synchronization with the audio.

scenes.thematicElements: Visual storytelling, image sequencing, technical precision.
scenes.title: Inserting and Adjusting Overlay Images

videoEditingDetails.description: Zooming in/out on the timeline for better image placement and duration adjustment.
Dragging and dropping the images in the timeline.

activities.description: Kirsten rearranges one of the images to correct the sequence.
She splits the audio track into segments to minimize echoes from overlapping clips.
Kirsten saves the final version of the project with overlay images.

narrativeProgression.description: Kirsten completes the overlay process by making final adjustments and exporting the edited video.

scenes.thematicElements: Attention to detail, problem-solving, finalizing the edit.
scenes.title: Final Adjustments and Export

videoEditingDetails.description: Zooming out on the timeline to show the overall arrangement.
Using the 'split tool' to divide the audio track.

climax.description: Kirsten saves the final version of the video with overlay images.

storylines.description: The video is primarily instructional, focusing on teaching viewers how to add overlay images to an interview in Movie Maker. It doesn't tell a story with a traditional plot or character development.

content_metadata.title: Demonstrating Overlay Images in Movie Maker

trimmingSuggestions.description: In Scene 2, the process of removing unwanted video clips could be shortened.
In Scenes 4 & 6, the audio and visual synchronization steps could be condensed.
The entire video could benefit from speeding up some segments where Kirsten navigates menus or makes minor adjustments that don't require detailed explanation.
